$comment: Source of truth for the periodic table. Add metadata by registering a facet in `facets` and filling it per element. See README.md.

ore-dedicated.label: Mined as a primary ore or concentrate
ore-dedicated.definition: The element is a principal commercial target of the mining operation.

byproduct-smelting.label: Recovered during refining of another metal
byproduct-smelting.definition: Economically recovered from smelting, leaching, or refining streams for another primary metal.

ion-adsorption-clay.label: Ion-adsorption clay extraction
ion-adsorption-clay.definition: Recovered from weathered clay deposits by ion-exchange leaching.

rare-earth-mineral.label: Rare-earth mineral concentrate
rare-earth-mineral.definition: Recovered from bastnaesite, monazite, xenotime, or related rare-earth minerals.

evaporite-brine.label: Evaporite or brine extraction
evaporite-brine.definition: Recovered from brines, salt lakes, seawater-derived streams, or evaporite minerals.

air-separation.label: Cryogenic air separation
air-separation.definition: Separated from atmospheric air by liquefaction and distillation.

hydrocarbon-gas.label: Hydrocarbon processing
hydrocarbon-gas.definition: Recovered from natural gas, petroleum, or related hydrocarbon processing streams.

synthetic.label: Artificially produced
synthetic.definition: Produced in nuclear reactors, particle accelerators, or other artificial nuclear processes.
